text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Chasing the thief who'd nabbed the girl's ghost and lifted the Spirit Orb of Resurrection from the oni vault, {0} and Satsuki had tracked him all the way to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幽霊を捕まえた上に鬼族の宝物庫から
『反魂の霊玉』を盗み出していった犯人の足取りを追って、
{0}とサツキはランドソルまで来ていた。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: What a massive city. It's got architecture a bit like Gio Nivlhel, but on a whole different scale...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんてデケェ街だ。
造りこそ
ジオ・ニヴルヘルにも、
似たもんはあるが……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: The cityscape here is dazzling. There are no cracks in the walls, and no tiles have fallen off. Seems like it's true that no house will decay if someone lives in it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちの街並みは眩しいな。
壁にヒビ割れもねェし、
瓦が落ちてもねェ。
人が住まなきゃ家は朽ちる
ってのァ本当だな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Eeeh. That Hungry Princess ain't too shabby.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……へぇ。
やるじゃあねェか、
腹ペコ姫さんも。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: I'd love to go sightseeing, but... Right now, we should be catching that thief rather than doing that. Can't believe some pickpocket scarpered to another world. If we don't nab him fast, we'll look like chumps in front of both my Princess and your Hungry Princess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこらをぶらつきてェところだが……
今は観光よりも追跡だ。
まさか
コソ泥が異世界まで逃げるたァな。
さっさととっ捕まえねえと、
ウチのお姫と腹ペコ姫に面目が立たねェ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: If this blows up into a spat between Landosol and Gio Nivlhel, one head isn't going to be enough to fix it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
話がこじれて
ランドソルとジオ・ニヴルヘルの問題にでもなったら、
俺の首一つじゃ済まねぇかんな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thanks to your many connections, brat Knight, it's quite easy to move around here. You have my gratitude.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あァ。
アチコチ顔の利く騎士公のおかげで
動きやすくて助かるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: The trouble is figuring where that bastard ducked off to. We got his trail to Landosol, but with this crowd, finding one guy is like needle-in-a-haystack work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
問題は
犯人の野郎がどこに行ったかだな。
どうにかランドソルまで足取りは追えたが……
こうも人が多いと
人捜しもままならねェ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Should we try to seek for gossip about ghost sightings? From the stories I've heard along the way, there's tales of a sobbing ghost talking of flowers so it doesn't seem like she's just being quiet and docile.
text_block_list.orig_text:
また幽霊の噂話でも集めるか？
道中聞いた話だけでも、
すすり泣く女だとか花の話だとか、
捕まった幽霊もただおとなしくしてるってわけでもなさそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Another miss, huh? Maybe daytime won't cut it. Where to next--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……また空振りか。
昼間じゃラチがあかねェかもしれねェな。
次はどっちに──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, brat Knight? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
騎士公？
どしたい。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Oi, oi. Taking care of others even at a time like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい。
こんな時でも他人の世話かよ。

text_block_list.name: Old woman
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks for the help... Carrying all this uphill is murder. You can't beat the years, I tell ya...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
支えてくれてありがとうよ……
さすがに大荷物を背負って坂道はキツいねぇ。
寄る年波には勝てないよ……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Lemme take that. I'll carry it. Heave-ho...
text_block_list.orig_text:
貸せよ。
運んでやる。
よっ、
と……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...What's this? Weapons and armor... bear traps? Oi, granny. Planning to fight an army or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんだ？
武器に防具に……
トラバサミだ？
おい婆さん。
カチコミかなんか行くつもりか？

text_block_list.name: Old woman
text_block_list.text: That's right. Heard there's been lots of grave-robbing lately. I don't want them disturbing the rest of my husband. I'm going to take them down with my own hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通り。
最近、
墓荒らしが出るようになったと聞いてねぇ。
死んだ爺さんの眠りを邪魔されちゃあたまらない。
この手でとっちめてやるつもりさ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Admirable spirit, but don't be biting off more than you can chew. Worry about your own back while you're still alive instead of your dead husband's.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見上げた心意気だが、
年寄りの冷や水だな。
死んだ旦那の前に、
生きてる自分の腰を心配してやんな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, brat Knight. To use the "Spirit Orb of Resurrection", you'll also need a corpse. High chance it's our culprit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あァ、
騎士公。
『反魂の霊玉』を使うなら
骸が必要になる。
もしかすると
犯人かもしれねェな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Granny. Meeting like this might be fate. Leave that grave-robber business to us, yeah? Might be the same fellow we're trailing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
婆さんよ。
袖すり合うも多生の縁だ。
その墓荒らしの件、
俺たちに任せちゃくれねェか。
もしかすっと、
その墓荒らしは
俺たちの追ってたヤツかもしれねェ。

text_block_list.name: Old woman
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well then, I'll take you up on your offer and ask the two of you to do it. Even if I ended up fighting, I think I'd just add one more grave to the pile.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなのかい？
それじゃあ、
お言葉に甘えて
二人にお願いさせておくれ。
老いぼれが戦ったところで、
墓が一つ増えちまうかもしれないからねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Well said. You can rest easy now, granny. The cavalry's here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしきた。
大船に乗った気でいな、
婆さん。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Graveyards in this world sure are peaceful. Not a single zombie's popping up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……こっちの世界の墓場ってのは
平和なモンだな。
ゾンビの一つも湧いてこねェ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat it. I'm just out of my element. If anything, you should relax your shoulders a little more, brat Knight--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にすんねぃ。
拍子が抜けちまっただけだ。
むしろ騎士公、
お前さんはもうちっと肩の力抜いとけ──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...No, hold it. Get ready. Looks like he's here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや、
待った。
構えとけ。
おいでなすったようだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: Finally... At last... Okay, I shall dig her up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっと……
やっとですね……
よし、
掘り起こしますよ……

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Ghost
text_block_list.text: Uu... uuu...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
うぅぅ……

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: By using this "Spirit Orb of Resurrection", I'll seal her spirit back into her corpse...! Haha... At last... I can finally bring her back to life...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この『反魂の霊玉』を使って、
骸へと霊体の魂を封じ込める……！
はは……
ようやくです……
ようやく、
生き返らせてあげられます……！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...What, you actually believe in that kinda fairy tale?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんだ。
お前さん、
黄泉返りなんてモンを信じてたのか？

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: Wh-Who are you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
誰ですか！？

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: A Rakshasa Oni from the deepest pit of the Netherworld, from the eight heats, eight colds and sixteen hells, come to drag you down by the neck. Now, hand over that "Spirit Orb of Resurrection".
text_block_list.orig_text:
冥府の闇の底の底、
八熱八寒十六地獄から
お前さんの首根っこを掴みにきた羅刹鬼さ。
その『反魂の霊玉』、
返してもらうぜ。

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: Kh...! So you chased me all the way here?! But you're too late! Come back to life! My beloved sister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ、
こんなところまで追ってきたんですか！
ですがもう遅い！
さあ、
蘇りなさいっ！　
私の最愛の妹よっ！

text_block_list.name: Young Girl's Zombie
text_block_list.text: Uu... uuuu... Flower... Happy... Flowers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
うぅぅぅ……
花……
シアワセノ……
オハナ……

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: ...Huh...? W-Why is she a zombie...? By using the "Spirit Orb of Resurrection" to seal her soul back into a corpse I should've been able to revive her...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えっ……？
ど、
どうしてゾンビが……？
『反魂の霊玉』を使って骸に魂を封じれば、
蘇生できるはず……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: What a fool. That orb only makes it easier to turn corpses into zombies. It doesn't have the power to resurrect anyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
馬鹿言ってんじゃねェ。
その『反魂の霊玉』は
死体をゾンビにしやすくするだけのモンだ。
人を蘇らせるような力なんざねェよ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Even if you did cram a ghost back into its body, that body's long since rotted away. It was a fool's dream from the start.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仮に幽霊ひっ捕まえて
骸に戻して蘇生できたとしても、
骸の傷みが進みすぎちまってる。
ハナから無理な話だぜ。

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: Th-That can't be... The ancient texts said it would bring her back...! I mean, I've already restored her back to the point she can move! If I continue my research like this, then maybe one day she will...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……
文献にはこれで生き返ると……
……いや、
しかし動くところまでは来たんです！
このまま研究を重ねれば、
いつかは完全な蘇生すらも……！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Thick-headed bastard... Guess I'll just knock some sense into you myself...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わからず屋が……
横っ面引っぱたいて、
目ェ覚まさせてやるぜ……！

text_block_list.name: Young Girl's Zombie
text_block_list.text: UWAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ウゥァァアアアッ！！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. She's become a mere zombie, only good at thrashing around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……チ。
暴れるだけしか能のねェ、
ゾンビになっちまったか。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...No magical power or strength to speak of, just a fragile little kid's corpse. Easy enough to crush... But still...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……魔力も腕力もねェ、
餓鬼のゾンビだ。
潰すのなんざワケはねェ。
しかし──……

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Ghost
text_block_list.text: Flowers... Where are the flowers...? I want the kind of flowers that can make me happy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お花……
お花はどこ……？
幸せになれる、
お花がほしいの……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...DAMMIT!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……クソッ！

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: Th-There's no way I can stop her! Even if I can create one, there was no description on how to control one in that tome...
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
止められるわけがないですよ！
呼び起こすことはできても、
コントロールなんて
文献の記述にも……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Destroy the "Spirit Orb of Resurrection". Doing so should also end the zombification.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……『反魂の霊玉』を砕け。
そうすりゃ
ゾンビ化も解けるはずだ。

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: I... I don't want to... I finally found a lead to reviving my sister! There's no way I can let her go like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い…………
いやだ…………
せっかく見つけた、
妹を蘇生する手掛かりなんです！
こんなところで手放せるはずがありません！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Oh, figured as much. If you're unable to settle things by yourself, then I'll do you the honors.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あァ、
そうかい。
手前で落とし前をつけられねェってんなら、
俺がやってやるよ。

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: Ugh... M-My spirit orb! G-Give it back... Please give it back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぐっ……
わ、
私の霊玉が！
かっ、
返して……
返してください！

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: I-I know...! Once I have established a foolproof method for reviving the dead, I will revive anyone you wish! So, that spirit orb...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうだ……！
死者蘇生の方法を確立した暁には、
あなたの望む者を蘇らせてあげます！
だからその霊玉を……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: This spirit orb doesn't belong in this world. And you're nowhere near ready to play with that kind of toy. ...Let it go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この霊玉はこの世界にあっちゃなんねェし、
お前さんにゃ過ぎたおもちゃだ。
……
全部諦めな。

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: N–No... My research... my dream of resurrection... my hope...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……
死者蘇生の、
夢が……
私の希望が……

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Ghost
text_block_list.text: Ugh... flowers that make me happy... I want flowers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
幸せになれるお花……
お花がほしいの……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Here. A flower. Took me a while, so it's pretty wilted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ほら、
花だぜ。
時間が経ったから、
ずいぶんしおれちまったけどな。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Ghost
text_block_list.text: Ahh... A flower... so pretty... Now I'm sure... I can make him... happy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
お花……
キレイ……
これなら……
きっと幸せに……
できる……

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Ghost
text_block_list.text: ...Be happy... Onii-chan...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……幸せになってね……
お兄ちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... She vanished... She's gone... When I had finally found her...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ……
消えた……
消えてしまった……
ようやく見つけたのに……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: So she finally passed on, huh? Looks like her lingering regret was not being able to give you flowers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
成仏したか……
未練は
花を贈ることだったみてぇだな。

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: Yes... My sister... she died in an accident while she was out picking flowers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
妹は
花を摘みに行くときに……
事故死でした……

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: I... at any cost... just wanted to see my sister again... Uuu...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私
は……
どうしても……
妹に、
もう一度
会いたくてっ……
うぅっ……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: It's better this way -- at least she found peace. Beats crying her regrets away forever, or rotting into some mindless corpse that attacks people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
成仏できて、
マシだったと思いな。
……未練抱えたまま泣き続けたり、
脳まで腐って
誰かを襲うよりかはな。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After turning the grave robber over to the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE, {0} and Satsuki reburied the body whose zombification had worn off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
墓荒らしを【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】に引き渡してから、
{0}とサツキはゾンビ化が解けた遺体を
墓へと再び埋葬した。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: That should do it. I even splurged on some rice dumplings and incense as offerings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでよし、
と。
供えの団子と線香も、
奮発してやったぜ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: You too, brat Knight. ...Thanks for seeing it through with me. Sorry for dragging you into this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士公もな。
……
最後まで付き合ってくれて、
あんがとよ。
すまなかったな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. She's probably up in the sky by now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あぁ。
今ごろ空にでも昇ったか──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. The sun in this world is way too bright...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ったく。
こっちの世界の太陽ってやつぁ
眩しすぎるな……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it's certainly not bad.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ま、
悪かねェのは確かだな。

text_block_list.name: Grave Robber
text_block_list.text: I... at any cost... just wanted to see my sister again... Uuu...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は……
どうしても……
妹に、
もう一度
会いたくてっ……
うぅっ……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Yo, brat Knight. Sorry to spring this on you, mind tagging along a little longer?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よぅ、
騎士公。
済まねぇついでに──
もうちっと付き合ってくれねェか？

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: In Gio Nivlhel... there's someone I want you to meet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジオ・ニヴルヘルで、
お前さんに会わせてぇヤツがいるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Satsuki's sudden proposal hung in the air, as the newborn sun bathed her and {0} in dazzling light...
text_block_list.orig_text:
唐突に提案するサツキ。
昇ったばかりの太陽は、
{0}とサツキを眩く照らし続ける……
